description: Amendments to the consented scheme drawings and conditions are sought by the Applicant: To reflect changes to their commercial and operational requirements for this development , and Design development of the consented scheme to meet building regulations and improve the buildability of the scheme. 1. Increase in hotel rooms; from 110 to 120.2. Rationalisation of fenestration; positions and style.3. Removal of rainscreen cladding.4. Rationalisation of amenity terraces; to comply with current fire regulations.5. Rationalisation of internal circulation; to comply with current fire regulations.6. Removal of double height spaces; within co-living uses.7. Re-design of basement level.8. Re-configuration of cycle storage.9. Re-configuration of refuse storage.10. Re-configuration of parking spaces.11. Addition of amenity access from Block D.12. Removal of Block D external walkway.13. Addition of roof maintenance stair access to Block A and C roofs.14. Re-design of SUDS strategy
